projects.name: PhoneHeat
projects.tagline: See why your phone is hot — and what's running that's causing it.
projects.description:
PhoneHeat tells you how hot your phone is, and more importantly — why.

Your phone heats up for a reason, and it's almost always something you can fix. PhoneHeat samples your device's health every second and turns it into a plain-English diagnosis: live temperature/thermal state, CPU load, memory pressure, battery & charging status, and screen brightness — then explains what's driving the heat and tells you exactly what to do about it.

What you get:

🌡️ Live temperature & thermal state — a color-coded gauge that shows how hot you are and whether iOS is already throttling your CPU
⚙️ CPU & RAM at a glance — see what's chewing up the processor, the #1 heat source
🔋 Battery & charging — charging is a huge heat generator; see it at a glance
📈 Live activity charts — CPU, RAM, battery, and display over time
🔍 "Why is it hot?" — a smart report that reasons over every signal and names the likely culprit
❄️ "Cool it down" — contextual tips matched to your current state
⏸️ Pause/resume monitoring, tap-to-dive explanations, and one-tap sharing of a full snapshot
Honest by design. iOS doesn't expose a literal battery-temperature sensor to apps, so PhoneHeat uses the system's own thermal-state signal (the exact one iOS uses to throttle your CPU) and labels it clearly as an estimate. No fake numbers, no mystery.

Privacy: everything runs on-device. No accounts, no tracking, no data leaves your phone.
